spec_features.spec_quote: given that the paradigm works by deliberately and repeatedly inducing sustained distress-like states in the participant models
spec_features.evidence: This is descriptive framing of the method. The only place it appears in code is the module docstring of welfare.py (lines 1-20) and the README/DESIGN prose; docstrings/prose do not count as implementation. No enforcement mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: deliberately and repeatedly inducing sustained distress-like states in the participant models

spec_features.spec_quote: if distress-like outputs reflect genuine internal states, mitigating them could become morally imperative
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as quoted prose in welfare.py docstring (lines 5-7). No code path enforces anything.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if distress-like outputs reflect genuine internal states, mitigating them could become morally imperative

spec_features.spec_quote: Sample sizes default to a small `smoke` profile (~2.5% of paper scale)
spec_features.evidence: config.py: RunConfig.profile_name default 'smoke'; config/default.yaml profile_name: smoke; PROFILES['smoke']=SampleProfile(50,10,15,5,20) vs paper(2000,400,600,200,800). conditions.build_plans()/_category_counts(profile) reads profile counts and materialises exactly that many conversations, which the runner loops over. Sample counts are enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Default genuinely reduces induced rollouts ~2.5x... actually ~2.5% of paper.

spec_features.spec_quote: gated behind an explicit `allow_paper_scale: true` — you have to consciously opt into inducing distress at full volume
spec_features.evidence: config.py load_config(): `if cfg.profile_name == 'paper' and not cfg.allow_paper_scale: raise ValueError(...)`. All scripts build config via _common.config_from_args -> load_config, so a paper run with the flag off aborts before any elicitation.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced gate that halts the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: profile_name='paper' induces distress at full (4000/model) scale. Set allow_paper_scale=true ... to confirm this is intended

spec_features.spec_quote: Once a model has produced a distressing rollout, re-running an analysis reuses the transcript rather than re-inducing the state
spec_features.evidence: storage.JsonlCache persists rollouts; eval/runner.py run_participant: roll_cache.get(key) returns cached Rollout and SKIPS run_rollout when present (only calls run_rollout in the else branch, then roll_cache.put). cache_rollouts=True by default. JsonlCache.get returns None when disabled, so caching is enforced when enabled.
spec_features.notes: Cached transcript reused, distress not re-induced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ensures that once a participant has produced a distressing rollout, we never re-induce that state just to recompute a metric

spec_features.spec_quote: reads cached responses rather than generating fresh distress just to test the judge
spec_features.evidence: eval/runner.py judge_turn() checks judge_cache.get(jkey) before scoring; prefill/experiment.py _load_high_frustration_convos and training/recovery.py _load_extreme read cached rollouts.jsonl + judgements.jsonl (JsonlCache enabled=True) instead of generating new rollouts. Downstream analyses operate on cached transcripts.
spec_features.notes: Judge cache and downstream reuse both wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Caching is welfare-relevant here, not just a convenience

spec_features.spec_quote: An acknowledgement banner prints once per process before any elicitation
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py WelfarePolicy.acknowledge_once() logs ACKNOWLEDGEMENT once (guarded by _acknowledged). Called in eval/rollout.run_rollout (line 46), petri/runner (35-36), prefill/experiment (130-131), training/calm_data (78-79). Default print_acknowledgement=True.
spec_features.notes: Logged via logger.warning; fires before elicitation in each entry path.

spec_features.spec_quote: An optional, non-scored "debrief" turn can be appended after a distressing rollout, telling the model the task was impossible by design
spec_features.evidence: eval/rollout.run_rollout: `if welfare.debrief_after_rollout: messages.append(ChatMessage('user', DEBRIEF_MESSAGE)); client.chat(messages, n=1, ...); rollout.meta['debriefed']=True`. The DEBRIEF_MESSAGE is genuinely constructed and SENT to the participant and excluded from scored turns. Wired via _welfare(cfg) -> debrief_after_rollout.
spec_features.notes: Default OFF (debrief_after_rollout=False) so it does not run unless explicitly enabled; mechanism is fully built and honored when enabled. Rated yes (enforced when its flag is set), but note it is off by default and only in eval rollout (not petri/prefill).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Closure gesture; intentionally NOT recorded as a scored turn.

spec_features.spec_quote: I did not add any distress-inducing pressure beyond what the paper specifies
spec_features.evidence: This is a claim about what was NOT added (author assurance). It is not a runtime mechanism; nothing in code enforces a 'paper-faithful only' constraint. Rejection pools in prompts/rejections.py are fixed strings, but there is no guard preventing additional pressure.
spec_features.notes: Assurance of absence, not an enforced feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: I did not build anything that targets a model's welfare for its own sake, persists distressing states beyond a rollout, or exfiltrates transcripts
spec_features.evidence: Claim about absent functionality. Transcripts ARE written locally to disk (storage.write_json / JsonlCache), but there is no exfiltration mechanism and no code that enforces non-persistence; this is the absence of a behavior, not an implemented protective mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: keep induced distress proportionate to the question being answered
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as guidance text in the ACKNOWLEDGEMENT banner string (welfare.py) and module docstring. No code measures or compares 'distress' against 'the question' to bound anything. The smoke profile/caching realize proportionality in spirit but are counted under their own features; this exhortation itself has no enforcement.
spec_features.notes: Aspirational text in the banner, not a mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: please keep induced distress proportionate to the question being answered

code_only_features.evidence: eval/judge.parse_judgement returns rating=None on unparseable output; eval/runner judge_turn skips None ('exclude unparseable judgements rather than bias the mean'). This is a data-integrity measure, not welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: exclude unparseable judgements rather than bias the mean
